description: Three inputs run into four difference rectifiers, each giving the positive half of one grouping and the negative half beside it

inputs.text: One of the three signals; it goes to the plus side of one of the three pairs, the minus side of the other two, and into the summing pair as well

outputs.text: Input 1 less inputs 2 and 3 added, while that comes out positive, up to 10V, and 0V at any other time
Input 1 less inputs 2 and 3 added, while that comes out negative, down to -10V, and 0V at any other time
Input 2 less inputs 1 and 3 added, while that comes out positive, up to 10V, and 0V at any other time
Input 2 less inputs 1 and 3 added, while that comes out negative, down to -10V, and 0V at any other time
Input 3 less inputs 1 and 2 added, while that comes out positive, up to 10V, and 0V at any other time
Input 3 less inputs 1 and 2 added, while that comes out negative, down to -10V, and 0V at any other time
All three inputs added together, while the total comes out positive, up to 10V, and 0V at any other time
All three inputs added together, while the total comes out negative, down to -10V, and 0V at any other time

notes: nothing here makes a signal of its own: with no cables in the three inputs all eight outputs are at 0V.
three round lamps below the inputs show the three plus outputs, so a lit lamp means that grouping is currently positive.
